summary: Public transport as the player lays it out (stops, tracks, lines) and the rail network they form

state.memberLine: TransitState transit; // public transport: stops, tracks, lines and the rail network (sim/transit)

pending.reason: reading a saved city is the save format's: it writes and reads TransitState and calls reindex after loading
player actions are commands (undo journal, money, touch()) calling these edits under the exclusive lock
the API exposes the queries to the interface; the UI never writes the state

m.reason: m(x) is x metres in world units; the 4.0 has METERS_PER_UNIT = 1 and the game's unit is the metre

Heap.type: std::priority_queue<std::tuple<$real, uint32_t, int>, std::vector<std::tuple<$real, uint32_t, int>>, std::greater<>>

members.pop: [&] { const int top = std::get<2>($self.top()); $self.pop(); return top; }()

Heap.reason: core/heap.ts orders by key, then by arrival (the key is the translation's number type, $real): a min priority_queue of (key, arrival, item) is the same order; the game has no heap of its own (core/job_pool.h uses std::priority_queue too)

patterns.reason: the 4.0 packs a cell's two integers into one key; the game's owner of cell keys is core/grid.h cell_key (any packing that is one-to-one is the same index)
